description.value: Harbour House Hotel is a historic waterfront property at the head of Ganges Harbour, Salt Spring Island, originally opened in 1916 and fully rebuilt after a two-year renovation. With 50 rooms — most overlooking the harbour — and an on-site farm-to-table restaurant sourcing from local island producers, it is widely regarded as the island's premier hotel. Touring cyclists will find it steps from Ganges Village and the famous Saturday Market.
